caption: The drawing depicts a single upright stone marker positioned on a flat, pale background. The marker is rectangular in shape with a rounded top and is vertically oriented, standing on a square plinth base. The stone's color is predominantly gray with various shading that suggests texture and depth, including some light brown and greenish undertones along the sides. The lower part of the marker has a rough, unpolished surface, while the upper portion is smoother and more finely detailed. At the top front face of the marker, the text "A. I. M." and the year "1822" are inscribed in black uppercase letters and numbers. The drawing uses realistic shading and detailing, capturing the material qualities and solidity of the object.
title: Plantation Boundary Marker
